name: fix126_map_filters
verifies: fix-126 ([owner]: 'where is the chest filter button? can the place names be switched off too? mark where I talked to quest people'): the map views (documents map, quest log world map) carry a filter bar inside the map's top-right corner (names, quests, companions, chests; the quest log has no names button); place names hide and show by their button and overlapping names are nudged apart (no overlap left); a quest dialog line records where the hero talked to the NPC (Gorn_ShowReddock: Gorn), drawn on both maps while the quest filter is on, the selected quest's mark highlighted on the quest log map; the marks survive save/load
steps: mapfilter names on=1; mapfilter quests on=1; chestfilter on=0
expect mapfilter:names=on; expect mapfilter:quests=on; expect mapfilter:chests=off
mapfilter names on=1; mapfilter quests on=1
expect mapfilter:quests=on; expect mapfilter:chests=off; expect mapfilter:names=hidden
notes: Setup as chapter_02_reddock up to Gorn's quest. questtalks / questtalk:Quest = talk marks recorded (all / of a quest); mapfilter:name = on/off of a filter button on the open map view (hidden: not on that view's bar), mapnames = place names shown, mapnamesnudged = names moved by the declutter, mapnamesoverlap = pairs of shown names still overlapping, mapquestmarks = quest talks drawn on the open map view, mapquestselected = marks of the selected quest (quest log), mapfit = the quest log map's projection was fitted from its place buttons. The filters are restored at the end. Shots: fix126_docs_map_filters (bar top-right inside the map, Ben Sala / Bakaresh apart, Gorn's mark), fix126_docs_map_clean (no names), fix126_questlog_map (bar, Gorn's mark named).
